# Copilot-specific guidance (delta — read AGENTS.md first)

`AGENTS.md` at the repo root defines scope, commands, iron rules, and the definition of done.
It is the single source of truth; this file holds Copilot-only additions and must never
duplicate or contradict it.

Copilot-only additions:

- Link the originating task/issue in the PR body.
- State which definition-of-done checks you ran, with actual command output.
- If your surface doesn't load `AGENTS.md` automatically, read it before the first change.
